mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Agent (office_id, address, license_number, agent_name, office_name, phone) VALUES (#{sysNo}, #{address}, #{number}, #{agentName}, #{officeName}, #{phone}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE address = #{address}, license_number = #{number}, agent_name = #{agentName}, office_name = #{officeName}, phone = #{phone}

INSERT INTO agent (office_id, address, license_number, agent_name, office_name, phone) VALUES
(#{office.sysNo}, #{office.address}, #{office.number}, #{office.agentName}, #{office.officeName}, #{office.phone})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE address = VALUES(address), license_number = VALUES(license_number), agent_name = VALUES(agent_name), office_name = VALUES(office_name), phone = VALUES(phone)
mapper.select: SELECT updated_at FROM openApiAgentsUpdate WHERE updated_key = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO openApiAgentsUpdate (updated_key, updated_at) VALUES (1, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO agentreview (office_id, user_id, created_at, content, listing_accuracy_score, cost_transparency_score, professionalism_score, accountability_score) VALUES (#{officeId}, #{userId}, NOW(), #{comment}, #{listingAccuracyScore}, #{costTransparencyScore}, #{professionalismScore}, #{accountabilityScore})
mapper.select: select office_id, Agent.address, license_number, agent_name, office_name, profile_image, phone, specialties, description, total_score from listing join Agent where listing.address like #{houseAddress} and listing.agency like Agent.office_name and (SUBSTRING( listing.address, 9, CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(listing.address, 9, 2) = '능동' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END ) like SUBSTRING( Agent.address, CHAR_LENGTH(Agent.address) - LOCATE('(', REVERSE(Agent.address)) + 2, CASE WHEN SUBSTRING( Agent.address, CHAR_LENGTH(Agent.address) - LOCATE('(', REVERSE(Agent.address)) + 2, 2 ) = '능동' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END ) or substring(Agent.address, LOCATE('동', Agent.address) - 2, 3) is null);
mapper.update: UPDATE Agent SET total_score = #{trustScore} WHERE office_id = #{officeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OfficeGeography (office_id, gu, dong, lat, lng) VALUES (#{officeId}, #{gu}, #{dong}, #{lat}, #{lng}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE gu = #{gu}, dong = #{dong}, lat = #{lat}, lng = #{lng}
mapper.select: SELECT a.office_id AS office_id, a.address AS address, a.profile_image AS profile_image, a.office_name AS office_name FROM agentbookmark b LEFT JOIN Agent a ON b.office_id = a.office_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId}
